summary: Layer 1B expansion for the site-level data-center reliability stack finds one high-attention reference leader and two less obvious public-market mappings. Vertiv remains the context anchor for integrated power, cooling, BESS, services, and monitoring. Modine is a cleaner thermal-management discovery candidate because its filings explicitly tie AI/HPC heat loads to hybrid and liquid cooling demand. Aspen Aerogels is a small-cap speculative shadow candidate: its direct evidence is strongest in EV and energy-storage-system battery thermal barriers, while the data-center link depends on whether BESS safety and fire-propagation mitigation become a procurement bottleneck for behind-the-meter data-center storage.
